title: Diogenes of Oenoanda, Epicurean inscription; RU «Диоген из Эноанды. Эпикурейская надпись» [RU-gap]
author: Diogenes of Oenoanda
size: c. 300 fragments incl. new finds; est. 15–25k words
edition: William (Teubner 1907, public domain, archive.org); Smith 1993, Supplement 2003; Hammerstaedt & Smith 2014 (copyrighted)
ru_evidence: Russian Wikipedia cites only an amateur complete translation (ru.echafaud.org) and short studies (Verlinsky 1987; Melnikov 2009). No scholarly translation found.
en_evidence: Smith 1993 and Supplement 2003 (BMCR 2004.12.28); new fragments in Hammerstaedt & Smith 2014 (BMCR 2016.07.38)
value: The longest Greek philosophical inscription and a key Epicurean source: physics, ethics, utopia. Fragments found since 1993 have no scholarly Russian version.
ai_feasibility: medium-high: philosophical prose; fragment order and supplements need expert control
pilot_unit: Ethics treatise plus Letter to Antipater (Smith numbering), c. 5k words
